sourceTitle: Overnight Oats with Black Grapes and Almonds
sourceText:
Overnight Oats with Black Grapes and Almonds
By: Matt
Published: Friday, November 24, 2017 - 5:28pm

Ingredients




For the Oats
1 tbsp almond butter
1 cup almond milk
1⁄4 cup almonds (crushed)
1 tbsp chia seeds
1⁄2 tsp cinnamon ground
1⁄2 cup dark grapes
3⁄4 cup jumbo rolled oats

Preparation

1 Whisk together all ingredients in a medium sized bowl. 2 Spoon the mixture into a jar with a lid and close it. 3 Put it into the fridge for at least 4 hours, but preferably overnight before serving.
